Got questions? We’ve got answers

Find answers to common questions about eligibility, account registration, application tracking, and portal technicalities.

1. What is Scholarship.Nagaland.gov.in?
Scholarship.Nagaland.gov.in is an online platform established by the Government of Nagaland to provide access to various scholarships for eligible students in the state. It serves as a central hub for scholarship applications, processing, and disbursement.
2. Who can apply for scholarships on this portal?
Eligibility criteria vary depending on the scholarship program. Generally, scholarships are available for students at different educational levels and are determined by factors such as income, academic performance, and category (SC/ST/OBC/General).
3. How do I create an account?
Visit the portal and click on "Register." Enter your details, verify your mobile number, and create a password. Once verified, your account will be created successfully.
4. Can I edit my application after submission?
No, once submitted, applications cannot be edited. Please review all information carefully before submission.
5. How can I track my scholarship application?
Log in to your account to view latest status of your application.
6. When will I receive the scholarship amount?
Disbursement dates vary by program. Generally, funds are released after applications are processed and eligibility is verified.
7. Are there scholarships for economically weaker students?
Yes, many scholarships cater to students from economically disadvantaged backgrounds, often requiring income proof for eligibility.
8. Can I apply for multiple scholarships?
No, you can only apply for one scholarship at a time. Review the eligibility criteria carefully before applying.

Important Information

Please read before applying

1
Aadhaar Authentication is mandatory for all Scholarship Applications. All students are advised to register on DigiLocker before registering on this portal.
2
Aadhaar Authentication is done using DigiLocker. Applicants are advised to select/check consent for sharing “All Documents” at the time of DigiLocker verification.
3
Students are advised to ensure their Bank Account is Aadhaar Seeded. Please visit your respective bank branch to provide consent to seed your account with Aadhaar.
4
If you have multiple bank accounts, only one (1) account can be Aadhaar Seeded at any given time to receive scholarship via the NPCI Aadhaar Payment Bridge (NPCI‑APB).
5
Ensure that your registered Name and Date of Birth (DOB) match exactly as per Aadhaar.
